selections.comment: An interesting maiden featuring several with useful pedigrees who could go on from here. Pharitz Racing fields three, of which Pharitz Alanood has the most experience, and on last year's form, should appreciate a return to this track. French import Mdawi will have been well schooled when with Francois Rohaut, but now in the UK, he may just need this on his debut. Piccadilly Lady comes from a well-respected stable, but all her siblings needed a few runs and a mark to win. Former champion trainer Phil Collington has two nicely-bred juveniles, with KS MEMPHIS looking the pick on jockey bookings, and he's done well with that sire's stock at all levels.

Azure Angel was outclassed at Listed level last time but has dropped back below her last winning mark and could complete the tricast.
